The '''Draynor Village Rooftop Course''' is a [[Rooftop Agility Course]] located in [[Draynor Village]] that is available to players with 1 [[Agility]]. It is followed by the [[Al Kharid Rooftop Course]].

The Draynor Village Rooftop Agility course can be started by climbing the Rough Wall next to the wheat field '''''north''''' of Draynor's bank and is finished by climbing down a crate off of [[Ned]]'s house. Players get 120 experience from completing the course, including the 79 experience upon climbing down the crate at the end of the course. 

A player can complete this course in 43.2 seconds (72 [[ticks]]). Using this course, one can reach approximately 10,000 experience per hour.

Completing a lap of the Draynor Village Rooftop Course is a task in the easy [[Lumbridge & Draynor Diary]].

==Changes==
{{Subject changes header}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 8 May 2024
|update = Project Rebalance: Skilling & Poll 81 MTA Changes
|change =
The [[experience]] per hour gained at the course has been increased from ~9,000 to ~10,000, as a result of the following changes:
* The [[Agility]] level requirement of 10 has been removed.
* It is no longer possible to fail the [[Wall (Draynor Village Rooftop Course)|wall-cross]] and [[Tightrope (Draynor Village Rooftop Course)|tightrope]] obstacles in the course.
}}
